strings.title: Drowned in the Dry Pool
strings.hint: Where is the real water? Match the chlorine in his lungs to the club's pools… then ask who has a cart that can move a man without attracting attention on camera.
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: longtime assistant Saber Nouh.

For thirty years, he lived in the Captain's shadow, devising training programs the coach claimed as his own. Even the method bearing the victim's name at the international federation was Saber's, in his own handwriting. When the club decided to honor the coach with a statue and officially register the method under his name, something broke in the quiet man. He drowned him in the small training pool at dawn, then moved him on an equipment cart to the Olympic pool, drained for maintenance, to tell the world: "Your hero drowned where there was no water… just as I drowned where I had no name."

The matching chlorine in his lungs, the cart's route on camera, and his dawn access-card record proved his guilt.
strings.summary.text: Maintenance workers found Olympic swimming coach Faisal Anani lying at the bottom of the large pool, completely dry for three days for maintenance. The cruel irony: the autopsy established that he had drowned, his lungs full of chlorinated water. A man drowned in a pool without water… a puzzle that sent the press into a frenzy and left the investigator with the only logical question: where had he actually drowned?

strings.scene.address: Al-Abtal Club — the Olympic pool and indoor training pool
strings.scene.intro: There is no water at the apparent crime scene, yet there is water in the victim's lungs: the murder happened in one place and the body was displayed in another. The indoor training pool had recently been filtered and its cover carefully replaced… except for one hurried corner.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: The dry bottom where the body was placed
strings.scene.photos[1].cap: The indoor training pool — the uneven corner of the cover
strings.scene.notes[0]: Death by drowning; chlorine in the lung water matches the concentration used in indoor pools
strings.scene.notes[1]: The large pool has been dry for 3 days
strings.scene.notes[2]: An equipment cart moved at dawn without a logged task
strings.scene.notes[3]: One corner of the training pool cover was replaced hastily
strings.evidence[0].title: Lung Water Analysis
strings.evidence[0].desc: The chlorine and treatment levels match only the indoor training pool, neither the large pool nor tap water.
strings.evidence[1].title: Equipment Cart
strings.evidence[1].desc: Its wheels left an intermittent trail of water from the indoor pool to the edge of the large pool.
strings.evidence[2].title: Dawn Access Card Log
strings.evidence[2].desc: Only two cards were used before six: the coach's… and his longtime assistant's.
strings.evidence[3].title: Tribute Letter
strings.evidence[3].desc: A decision to officially register the "Anani Method" under the coach's name and place a statue at the entrance, to be announced in a week.
strings.evidence[4].title: Original Training Notebooks
strings.evidence[4].desc: Thirty years of training plans in Saber's handwriting, including the "Anani Method," word for word.
strings.evidence[5].title: The Dismissed Swimmer's Threat
strings.evidence[5].desc: A swimmer the coach removed from the national team wrote: "I'll make you drink from the same cup." An initial lead.
strings.suspects[0].name: Adham, the Dismissed Swimmer
strings.suspects[0].relation: The victim removed him from the national team
strings.suspects[0].alibi: "I've been at a private training camp outside the city for a week. The replacement coach can confirm it."
strings.suspects[0].statement: I hated him for destroying my dream with a hasty decision, and my message was a moment of anger. But I was three hundred kilometers away, training to prove him wrong. That's my only revenge.
strings.suspects[1].name: Saber Nouh
strings.suspects[1].relation: His constant shadow and the creator of his training methods
strings.suspects[1].alibi: "I arrived at half past six as usual. I live far away."
strings.suspects[1].statement: Faisal was both my lifelong friend and my lifelong rival. Yes, his methods came from my notebooks. Everyone at the club knows and stays silent; silence is a job here. But who kills a man who carries half his life on his shoulders? My card? Perhaps the system made a mistake. It happens often.
strings.suspects[2].name: Raja, the Club Director
strings.suspects[2].relation: A public dispute over the tribute budget
strings.suspects[2].alibi: "I was at the airport welcoming the federation delegation. The tickets and photographs are timestamped."
strings.suspects[2].statement: I objected to the cost of the statue, not the man. His death a week before the tribute is a publicity disaster that will cost my budget many times more than the statue. I stand to lose the most here.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Morning Lifeguard
strings.witnesses[0].statement: The indoor pool cover had been hastily replaced at the eastern corner. Captain Saber never leaves anything uneven, except that morning.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Gate guard
strings.witnesses[1].statement: Captain Saber's car was in the lot before half past five, although he greeted me on his way in at half past six as if he had only just arrived.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Junior Swimmer
strings.witnesses[2].statement: Our dawn practice was canceled by a nighttime message from the assistant's account: "Pool reserved for maintenance." No maintenance had been scheduled.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Maintenance Report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: Maintenance workers reported a body at the bottom of the drained pool.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Drowning Report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Typical drowning in chlorinated indoor pool water; a grip bruise behind the neck indicates that the victim's head was held underwater.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Water Trail Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: Intermittent drops follow the cart's route from the training pool to the large pool. A corridor sample matches the training pool water.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Swimmer Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: The out-of-town camp is confirmed by the replacement coach and hotel cameras.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Assistant Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: He maintained that it was a "system error" until shown the gate guard's testimony about his car at dawn. After a long silence, he said: "The small pool knows the truth."
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Director Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: Timestamped airport photographs cover the entire critical window.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Training Cancellation Log
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: The nighttime cancellation was sent from the assistant's account at 23:40, clearing the pool of witnesses in advance.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Notebook Comparison
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: The "Anani Method" submitted to the federation is a word-for-word copy of Saber's handwritten notebooks from the nineties.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: An Unsent Message
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: In the victim's phone drafts: "I'll put things right at the tribute and name you as my partner, Saber, as I should have thirty years ago." The message was never sent.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Confession Record
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: When he read the unsent message, Saber wept and said: "If he'd sent it… we'd be training together now." He fully confessed to the method and route.
strings.reports[0].title: Two Scenes Report
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: The murder scene was the indoor pool; the display scene was the dry pool. Moving the body was a symbolic message, not concealment. The killer wanted his anger to be understood.
strings.reports[1].title: Thirty Years Report
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: Stealing someone's name is the slowest kind of killing. The official tribute was the last straw; the murder was revenge for an entire stolen life.
strings.notes[0].text: Drowning without water = two scenes. Find the first.
strings.notes[1].text: Who canceled dawn training the night before?
